script: Chapter 3. Hardware: Building Your Workstation. Your workstation has layers. At the bottom is the hardware. Above it are the operating system, the browser and office tools, the SEO tools, and finally your client work. Start with a starter setup: 8 to 16 GB of RAM, an SSD, and a headset. Upgrade screens and storage as your income grows. Practice: check your RAM and storage in Task Manager or Activity Monitor. Recap: reliability first, then upgrades.
glossary: workstation, RAM, SSD, UPS, headset, operating system
